name: Romul Mobs
source: Half-orc Romulus spent his entire life in Dale's criminal circles but got tired of constant run-ins with the police and decided to settle down. He got a job as a bouncer at Lady Luck nightclub and tries to lead an honest life, though he still can't deny himself the pleasure of extorting bribes.
